objective.en: Find where the June 2024 rainstorm is dumping the most rain before streets flood.

sources.name: NASA GPM IMERG daily precipitation rate (GIBS layer IMERG_Precipitation_Rate)
sources.usage: Hazard cells = top 18% of peak daily GPM IMERG precipitation rate during the 11-14 June 2024 South Florida rainstorm (2024-06-11..2024-06-14). eventDay = day a cell received a quarter of its event total. The hazard cut-off is a game choice.

sources.name: Mission: Possible cloud and detectability model
sources.usage: cloudProbability (baseline 0.78 for this storm setting) and detectability are seeded educational estimates, not observations.
